items.title: Can Hedging and Long-Term PPAs Strengthen Vistra's Growth?
items.summary: VST's heavy hedging and 20-year nuclear PPAs with AWS and Meta aim to lock in revenues, steady cash flow and support long-term growth.

items.title: Can Rising C&I Demand Drive Constellation Energy's Long-Term Growth?
items.summary: CEG secures long-term nuclear demand from C&I customers, boosting revenue visibility and supporting EPS growth.

items.title: Vistra CEO James Burke Buys 2,000 Shares After 29% Stock Decline
items.summary: Burke's $270,000 indirect purchase boosts his total beneficial interest to $167.63 million, signaling confidence at current valuations.

items.title: Vistra Stock Is Down, But Is This Power Producer's Dip An Opportunity?
items.summary: The company is chasing the data center boom, but after a pullback in the shares, you have to weigh a strong recovery record against some very real market pressures.

items.title: CEG vs. VST: Which Nuclear Utility Stock Stands Out for Investors?
items.summary: Vistra stands out among nuclear utility stocks with stronger earnings growth, higher ROE and margins, and a cheaper valuation, despite more debt.

items.title: Vistra Won’t Stop Declining in 2026: Why Does This Prominent Wall Street Firm Expect 120% Returns?
items.summary: Vistra has shed nearly 30% over the past year while one prominent Wall Street firm just slapped a target on it that implies triple-digit gains. The reasoning behind that call cuts against almost everything the market currently believes about power prices and AI demand.

items.title: Thanks Nvidia, But These Power Stocks Have Other Ways to Win
items.summary: The midterm elections can’t come soon enough for AI power stocks.  Politicians in red and blue states are vowing to slow data center development.  Developers and power companies may be more inclined to announce deals after voting ends and the political pressure eases.

items.title: Vistra Stock Sits 37% Below Its High While Power Demand Keeps Climbing. Should You Buy It?
items.summary: The power producer's adjusted EBITDA is up more than 30% and its nuclear fleet is signing 20-year deals with tech giants. The stock is priced like none of that happened.
